authorization_basis: User explicitly requested outlier filtering on existing tasks and repeated testing to seek a stable conclusion. This separately declared study includes q001 under that new instruction; prior q001 phases remain closed and unchanged. New candidate issue preparation is deferred.
purpose: Apply the pinned PR261 within-task score-tail filter to ten fresh repeats on each existing task and quantify observed repeatability. No new task selection, pooling with history, favorable stopping or replacements.

statistics.score_trimming: Exactly one minimum and one maximum score per task/profile; deterministic trial_index then original-position ties; use the same retained tuples for every resource metric.
statistics.task_screening: Use unchanged one-pass upper-tail modified-Z/MAD policy. Three tasks are below the five-task guard, so task screening is explicitly unavailable and all tasks remain.
statistics.unknown_or_invalid_evidence: Retain every scheduled execution and failure. Never replace unavailable quality or usage with zero or silently drop an invalid observation. Full statistical conclusions require the planned evidence to be available; otherwise report incomplete scope and missing counts.
statistics.measurement_scope: Claude-reported per-model input including uncached, cache-read and cache-write; output separate, complete persisted root/child corroboration separate; no monetary-cost claim.
statistics.time_scope: Harbor agent_execution for PR-compatible variability screening; separately retain native run, fresh setup/index and outer-slot elapsed time over the same retained tuples.

stability_analysis.strong_observed_efficiency_condition: For each fixed task and equal-weight all-task macro, in BOTH raw and score-trimmed views: paired bootstrap 95% lower bound for input reduction >0, score delta >=0, and original quality-pass-rate delta >=0. Every scheduled execution/scope and reported-metric audit must be valid, including relevant correct-root zg retrieval.
stability_analysis.variance_question: Compare raw/trimmed score sample SD, agent-time/input-token CV and paired bootstrap interval widths. Explicitly report metrics whose variability increases or remains unchanged.
stability_analysis.time: Agent/native/full-slot time reductions and intervals are secondary. Do not infer total-time savings from input savings.
stability_analysis.quality: An efficiency stability result alone does not establish an adequate-quality benchmark set; show absolute original quality-pass rates and each task core failures.
stability_analysis.scope: Descriptive repeatability for three fixed previously observed tasks, not population inference or contamination freedom. No calibrated multiple-comparison guarantee or proof of provider/model determinism.

grading_policy.original_semantics: Original q001 grader contract and original q002/q003 expansion grader contract unchanged; exact original question, source and rubric per task. No sensitivity substitutions or regrades for favorable outcomes.
grading_policy.packets: Each task has 20 exact-byte final answers with preassigned random anonymous IDs and shuffled answer order, original grading inputs and frozen source. No labels, pair/repeat IDs, trajectories, resources, outcomes or mapping are supplied to the scorer.
grading_policy.unblinding: Persist original grades and consistency checks before explicit mapping read; document scorer exposure and any parent side-channel limitations. Root execution audits are condition-aware and root is not claimed blind.
grading_policy.missing_answers: Preserve absence/failure and scheduled counts. Do not replace trials, zero-fill unknown evidence or draw complete-study conclusions from an available favorable subset.
grading_policy.reporting: Show original score, per-criterion core/citation gates, quality pass rates, execution/scope/accounting validity, and every individual raw/retained/excluded identity after unblinding.

upstream_verification.current_rust_equivalence: Current main and pinned binary revision have identical complete Rust trees. Intervening commits change container shutdown benchmark behavior and CI triggers only. Keep the verified harness and runtime unchanged.
upstream_verification.preflight_policy: Each preflight records the actual current main commit and complete root tree, then requires its rust subtree SHA to match the pinned runtime. Unrelated non-Rust main commits are recorded, not false rejections. A changed Rust tree blocks execution.

execution_gate: First push the frozen controls to Cuiyus/zvec-grep, inspect same-commit provider-free preflight and all 30 dry runs. Then make exactly one workflow_dispatch execute_repeats=true at that exact branch head. Each fresh pair validates all frozen controls, task identity and original runtime. GitHub run_attempt must equal1.
stopping: Finish all 30 scheduled pairs with no favorable-result early stop, retries, replacements or after-outcome rule changes. Existing phase 39353782766 is retained in full and is not restarted.
limits: A failed/missing audit remains failed even if its execution is score-trimmed. Preserve all 60 planned rows. Unknown model/provider/embedding billing remains unknown.
plan_binding: The plan pins this decision and the execution sidecar pins the exact plan SHA; no circular digest.

preflight_revision.change: Replace main-tip equality with current complete Rust-tree equality; retain actual tip/tree. Use the unchanged standalone stdlib secret scanner and initialize retention before setup, preserving early failures. Original solver/runtime, tasks, scoring, scheduling and statistics unchanged.
